policy.purpose: Persist explicit user decisions separately from semantic fit and vacancy lifecycle status.
policy.default: No record means no explicit user decision.
policy.not_interested: Suppress from normal reports while the same vacancy fingerprint remains open. If the fingerprint materially changes, force re-review.
policy.applied: Suppress from apply-now list while continuing open/updated/closed monitoring.
policy.interested: Keep in active shortlist while open.
policy.generalization: Never infer a company-wide or role-family exclusion from one vacancy decision.
policy.fingerprint_rule: Store the fingerprint at the time of a vacancy-specific decision. NOT_INTERESTED is invalidated by a fingerprint change; TO_REVIEW, INTERESTED and APPLIED persist across updates.
